reason: The Q1 FY26 analyst presentation from Siemens Energy (February 2026) does not disclose any total addressable market (TAM) figures. The document focuses on operational and financial results, including order intake (€17.6bn), revenue (€9.7bn), profit margins, cash flow, order backlog (€146bn), and segment-specific performance metrics for Gas Services, Grid Technologies, Transformation of Industry, and Siemens Gamesa. While the company discusses strong market momentum, capacity expansions, and regional demand growth, no TAM estimates or market size figures are provided by the company in this filing.
